My Salutations to all Pious Souls....

It gives me great pleasure to inform all of you that on 8.12.2022, Thursday, the Khad Muhurat programme will take place at Gujarat Samarpan Ashram, Mahudi, where the Shree Guru Shakti Dham, Gandhinagar is located. This Shree Guru Shakti Dham will be built on 20 acres of land - this will be the grandest and biggest Shree Guru Shakti Dham in the world. On this occasion, a Land Purification Yagya has been organised by the Samarpan Dhyan Sanskar Family.

The land will be purified through the medium of a Modak Havan - all of you are invited.

Lots of blessings to all of you.

Your own
Baba Swami
